headline: Commodity inflation persists; EU restructuring to drive profitability ahead

highlights: Current demand momentum remains healthy in India biz., though we expect growth to moderate during H2 given a high base and steep price hike(s).
We cut our FY27E margin by 40bps but maintain it for FY28–29.
Q2FY27: Revenue in line, margins below estimate APTY reported standalone revenue of INR 59.2bn (+26% YoY/+8% QoQ), 4% above our estimate.
Standalone EBITDAM stood at 11.1% (-420bps YoY/ -90bps QoQ), broadly in line with our estimate.
valuation: The company took 11–13% price hike in H1 to partially mitigate the impact of RM inflation and it intends to take multiple price hikes in the near term.
